DestinationConfig.description_zh: 异步调用目标的配置信息

description_en: Queries all asynchronous configurations of a function in a service. If the number of configurations exceeds the limit, the nextToken parameter is returned. You can use this parameter for a subsequent paging query
description_zh: 查询一个服务下某个函数的所有异步配置。当配置个数超过limit个数时，将返回nexttoken参数。可以使用该参数进行后续的分页查询
kebab_example: aliyun fc-open list-function-async-invoke-configs --service-name demo-service --function-name helloworld --api-version 2021-04-06 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListFunctionAsyncInvokeConfigs

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of results to return. If you do not specify this parameter, the default value is 20. The maximum value is 100. The number of returned results may be less than the specified value, but does not exceed it
parameters.help_zh: 最多返回个数。 如果不设定，默认返回20，最大不能超过100。返回结果可以小于指定的数量，但不会多于指定的数量
parameters.name: limit

parameters.help_en: The token used to retrieve more results. You do not need to specify this parameter for the first query. You can obtain the token for subsequent queries from the response
parameters.help_zh: 用来返回更多结果。第一次查询不需要提供这个参数，后续查询的Token从返回结果中获取
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The ID of your Alibaba Cloud account
parameters.help_zh: 您的阿里云账号（主账号）ID
parameters.name: x_fc_account_id

parameters.help_en: The CRC-64 value of the function code package used to verify data integrity. This value should be automatically calculated by the tool
parameters.help_zh: 函数代码包的CRC-64值，用于校验完整性。应当由工具自动计算
parameters.name: x_fc_code_checksum

parameters.help_en:
Specifies the type of logs to return for the request. Valid values:
Tail: Returns the last 4 KB of logs generated by the current request.
None: Does not return request logs. This is the default value
parameters.help_zh:
请求返回日志。

Tail：返回当前请求产生的最后4 KB日志。
None：默认值，不返回请求日志
parameters.name: x_fc_log_type

parameters.help_en:
The invoke type. Valid values:
Sync: Synchronization invoke.
Async: Asynchronous invoke
parameters.help_zh:
调用方式。

Sync：同步调用。
Async：异步调用
parameters.name: x_fc_invocation_type

parameters.help_en: The invocation time of Function Compute, in the EEE, d MMM yyyy HH:mm:ss GMT format
parameters.help_zh: 函数计算调用时间，格式为EEE,d MMM yyyy HH:mm:ss GMT
parameters.name: x_fc_date

parameters.help_en: The trace ID of the Function Compute invocation request
parameters.help_zh: 函数计算调用请求的调用链ID
parameters.name: x_fc_trace_id

schema.description_zh: 查询异步配置结果结构体

createdTime.description_en: The creation time, in UTC and ISO 8601 format. Example: 2020-09-10T02:45:02Z
createdTime.description_zh: 创建时间，采用 ISO 8601 格式的 UTC 时间，例如 2020-09-10T02:45:02Z

destinationConfig.description_en: The configuration struct for the destination of asynchronous invocations. If this parameter is not configured, the value is null
destinationConfig.description_zh: 异步调用目标的配置结构体。如果您未进行配置，则该项为空值（Null）

lastModifiedTime.description_en: The last modified time, in UTC and ISO 8601 format. Example: 2020-09-10T02:45:02Z
lastModifiedTime.description_zh: 最后更改时间，采用 ISO 8601 格式的 UTC 时间，例如 2020-09-10T02:45:02Z

maxAsyncEventAgeInSeconds.description_en: The maximum lifetime of a message. If this parameter is not configured, the value is null
maxAsyncEventAgeInSeconds.description_zh: 消息最大存活时长。如果您未进行配置，则该项为空值（Null）

maxAsyncRetryAttempts.description_en: The maximum number of retries after an asynchronous invocation fails. If this parameter is not configured, the value is null
maxAsyncRetryAttempts.description_zh: 异步调用失败后的最大重试次数。如果您未进行配置，则该项为空值（Null）

maxAsyncRetryAttempts.title_zh: 异步调用失败后的最大重试次数

qualifier.description_en: The version or alias of the service

statefulInvocation.description_en:
Specifies whether asynchronous tasks are enabled. Valid values:
true: Asynchronous tasks are enabled.
false: Asynchronous tasks are disabled.

If this parameter is not configured, the value is null
statefulInvocation.description_zh:
是否开启异步任务。

true：表示已开启异步任务。
false：表示未开启异步任务。  

如果您未进行配置，则该项为空值（Null）

nextToken.description_en: The token for the next query
